meta.title: Power-Up
meta.description: Adds a right-click action menu to the Trajectory ledger: copy a record, copy a Markdown quote, quote it into the composer, open the record inspector, fork the session at that record, copy a step reference (session id + step id) that the read-only powerup_step_read tool resolves back into the raw session data, export the trajectory snapshot, and copy the session ID. The session header background jobs panel gains an optional stop reason when a job is stopped by hand; the reason is appended to the completion notice injected into the session. The Plugins page gains an install control on every third-party installed plugin: read versions from the registry, install the version in the input through the Add plugin path (removing the old copy first), then enable and optionally restart DSH. The install panel also offers a one-click install that installs the input version without the enable and restart questions, enabling and restarting automatically by default; both defaults are configurable on the Power-Up page. A sidebar launcher turns the left sidebar panel buttons into an adaptive icon grid (icon above label) with drag sorting and folders: drop an icon onto the middle of another to fold them into a folder like a Windows Start menu folder, click a folder to open its icons in a flyout, and switch the whole grid off on the Power-Up page.
